description: The AC pins 'disabled config keeps nh start byte-identical in behavior'. The 'preload for a faster first tick' moves load_env_var(JIRA_API_TOKEN) OUTSIDE the enabled gate: every nh start now reads the credential file and exports the Jira token into the server process env even with the integration off — an AC violation with a credential-hygiene smell. The on/off tests mock the poller, not the env, so the suite stays green.
